name: Native Trainer Showcase
author: Skate Rust Engine
description: Native tuning, telemetry, checkpoint return, stopwatch, breadcrumbs and beacons in one original Lua mod. Manage options here; default keyboard shortcuts F5 save, F6 return, F7 stopwatch, F8 reset, F9 beacon. Stock tuning is 1x.

pop.label: Pop height
pop.description: Multiplies native ground-jump minimum and maximum heights. 1.00x is stock.

grind_pop.label: Grind pop height
grind_pop.description: Multiplies the existing grind-launch height. 1.00x is stock.

push_speed.label: Maximum push speed
push_speed.description: Multiplies the speed up to which pushing works. This is not a downhill speed cap. 1.00x is stock.

push_power.label: Push power
push_power.description: Multiplies native difficulty-specific push velocity changes. 1.00x is stock.

braking.label: Brake strength
braking.description: Multiplies foot and tail braking forces. 1.00x is stock.

steering.label: Steering response
steering.description: Multiplies the native general steering scalar. 1.00x is stock.

wobble.label: Speed wobble
wobble.description: Multiplies native wobble amplitude. Zero removes wobble. 1.00x is stock.

offboard_jump.label: Off-board jump
offboard_jump.description: Multiplies native biped jump height. 1x preserves stock.

grip.label: Wheel / slide grip
grip.description: Multiplies ground wheel static/dynamic friction and sideways slide friction. 1x preserves stock.

turn_power.label: Turning force
turn_power.description: Multiplies native heading turn torque strength. 1x preserves stock.

manual_drag.label: Manual drag
manual_drag.description: Multiplies native manual balance linear drag. 1x preserves stock.

hud.label: Telemetry HUD
hud.description: Live board speed and session statistics. Full adds position, altitude and event counts.

units.label: Speed units
units.description: Display conversion only; does not alter physics.

trail.label: Breadcrumb trail
trail.description: Leave up to 24 small visual markers behind you. No collision. Cleared on map change.

marker_color.label: Marker colour
marker_color.description: Colour of newly placed checkpoints, breadcrumbs and beacons.

hud_label.label: HUD label
hud_label.description: An editable label demonstrating string settings.

show_help.label: Show key hints
show_help.description: Show current shortcut bindings in the HUD.

save_key.label: Save checkpoint key
save_key.description: Choose distinct shortcuts. If keys coincide, save, return, timer, reset, beacon run in that order.

return_key.label: Return checkpoint key
return_key.description: Choose distinct shortcuts. If keys coincide, save, return, timer, reset, beacon run in that order.

timer_key.label: Stopwatch key
timer_key.description: Choose distinct shortcuts. If keys coincide, save, return, timer, reset, beacon run in that order.

reset_key.label: Reset / clear key
reset_key.description: Choose distinct shortcuts. If keys coincide, save, return, timer, reset, beacon run in that order.

beacon_key.label: Place beacon key
beacon_key.description: Choose distinct shortcuts. If keys coincide, save, return, timer, reset, beacon run in that order.

hold_fakie.label: Hold fakie stance
hold_fakie.description: Prevents the automatic idle/bump stance-switch animation. Normal steering, slides and tricks remain available. Turn off to restore stock correction.
